Why this is public domain:
Text: the Robinson-Pierpont Byzantine Textform 2018 with notes by Robert Adam Boyd (living). The Robinson-Pierpont Byzantine Textform's notice reads: "This compilation is Copyright (C) 2018 by Maurice A. Robinson. Anyone is permitted to copy ... All rights to this text are released to everyone" (https://byzantinetext.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/robinson-pierpont-2018-gnt-edition.pdf; the 2005 edition's notice, https://byzantinetext.com/?p=111, is the same in substance). The maintainer's decision (2026-10-16): a copyright line beside a full release of all rights counts as a public-domain dedication. Editors: Maurice A. Robinson (living, United States) and William G. Pierpont. Boyd's own words on the edition's front page: "The text, introduction, footnotes, and appendices of this edition are hereby released into the Public Domain."

The verse-per-line archive holds the Bible text in one file, one verse per line, each line starting with its reference (book, chapter:verse); its SQL and XML copies of the same text, eBible.org's description page, style sheet and signature are left out of the source.

Sources of these facts: eBible.org's details page (https://ebible.org/details.php?id=grctcgnt), the edition's copyright page (https://ebible.org/grctcgnt/copyright.htm), https://ebible.org/grctcgnt/FRT01.htm; https://byzantinetext.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/robinson-pierpont-2018-gnt-edition.pdf; https://byzantinetext.com/?p=111.

note: The verse-numbered twin of ebible-grctcgnt-d653079d, for the parallel verses measure only (#35): its tag is verse-numbers alone, which no mixture selects, so it never enters training. eBible.org rebuilds this zip often; the checksum covers the files inside.
